literal: effort he who lacks generosity coward hand sword-wielding like will fail
translation: The generosity of a man who lacks industrious effort will fail, just like a sword wielded in the hand of a coward.
modern: முயற்சி இல்லாதவன் பிறருக்கு உதவி செய்ய நினைப்பது, ஒரு பேடியின் கையில் உள்ள வாள் வீரம் பயன்படாமல் போவதைப் போல வீணாகிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet compares a lazy person's desire to be generous with a coward holding a sword. Just as a coward cannot actually fight despite holding a weapon, a person without industrious effort cannot sustain their generosity. The word தாளாண்மை means relentless effort, while வேளாண்மை here refers to the helpfulness or generosity that requires wealth generated by such effort. Without the former, the latter is merely an illusion and will ultimately fail.
